clues.text: Near Timnah, Samson found a swarm of bees in a lion's carcass and scooped this out to eat.
Not knowing Saul's oath, Jonathan dipped the end of his staff into this in a forest, and his eyes brightened.
In the wilderness of Judea, John the Baptist wore camel's hair and ate locusts along with this, wild.
At the burning bush, God promised to bring Israel out of Egypt to a land flowing with milk and this.
In the wilderness, the manna Israel gathered was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with this.
When Ezekiel ate the scroll God gave him, it tasted as sweet as this in his mouth.
Israel sent this to Egypt with his sons as a gift for the man, along with balm, myrrh and pistachios.
